# netbox_contact_assignment (Data Source)

Retrieves a single contact assignment from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_contact_assignment" "example" {
  id = 1
}

output "contact_assignment_id" {
  value = data.netbox_contact_assignment.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `contact_id` (Number) The ID of the contact associated with the contact assignment.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the contact assignment.
- `object_type` (String) The object type of the contact assignment.
- `role_id` (Number) The ID of the role associated with the contact assignment.

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) The created of the contact assignment.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the contact assignment, as a map of field name to value.
- `last_updated` (String) The last updated of the contact assignment.
- `object` (String) The object of the contact assignment.
- `object_id` (Number) The object id of the contact assignment.
- `priority` (String) The priority of the contact assignment.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
